description: The quorum boundary at the size the docker environment is built for. With 13 validators the quorum is floor(2n/3)+1 = 9, so nine producing must be enough and eight must not. The case stops four (leaving exactly nine) and requires production to continue, stops a fifth and requires it to halt, then restarts all five and requires it to resume -- so each half proves the other is not a coincidence. The four-node case (consensus/02) checks the same rule where the numbers are small; this one checks it where round changes have thirteen participants and two of the fifteen nodes are not validators at all.
